## Summary
Samanuai A is an open-source software engineer, systems architect, and the founder of OpenSyntaxHQ. He specializes in designing and building high-performance CLI/TUI developer toolchains, AI-assisted development platforms, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and scalable cloud systems.

## Primary Technology Stack
- **Languages**: TypeScript, Go, Java (OpenJDK / Spring Boot), Python, Rust, SQL, C/C++
- **Domain Specializations**: CLI & TUI Architecture, Terminal User Interfaces, AST Code Parsers, MCP Servers, Distributed Event Streams (Apache Kafka), Docker & Containerization

## Core Projects & Repositories
- **leetcode-cli** (TypeScript): Full-featured terminal CLI for competitive programming and LeetCode problem workflows.
- **tweak** (Go): High-performance developer utility toolchain.
- **brokr-platform** (Go): Distributed trading and broker integration platform.
- **OpenSyntaxHQ**: Open-source organization building modern terminal developer tooling and automated workflow engines.
